process.description: We assess your garage door system. You get a flat-rate price quote for the spring repair before we start work.
Our technicians replace broken springs with quality parts. We install high-cycle, oil-tempered torsion springs or extension springs with safety cables.
We replace worn parts like center and end bearing plates or winding cones as needed. Then we properly tension the new springs.
After repair, we perform a balance test and a safety-reverse test. Your door will operate smoothly and safely.
